# Lumi

> Lumi's core product is RunLumi: a local-first memory of the work on your computer, built in Vietnam and in early development. It helps a person recall what they saw, resume interrupted work and draft timesheets they approve, with capture that is opt-in and data that stays on their device. Lumi AI Workspace, Lumi BI and Lumi Agents are separate products for companies.

## Start here

- [Lumi home](https://runlumi.app/): what RunLumi does, how capture and privacy work, and the design-partner pilot.
- [Lumi vision](https://runlumi.app/vision): the direction behind RunLumi.
- [Lumi Journal](https://runlumi.app/blog): practical writing about evidence, bounded AI and people in control.
- [Lumi Journal in Vietnamese](https://runlumi.app/vi/blog): Vietnamese articles.
- [Lumi Journal RSS](https://runlumi.app/rss.xml): machine-readable updates from the editorial archive.
- [Lumi jobs](https://runlumi.app/jobs): current roles and the candidate-first application flow.

## Products

- RunLumi (early development, design-partner pilot on macOS): local work memory with recall, a day/week timeline and reviewed billable-time drafts.
- [Lumi AI Workspace](https://workspace.runlumi.app): coordinate decisions, commitments, risks and operating work.
- [Lumi BI](https://about.bi.runlumi.app): understand what changed and trace conclusions to evidence.
- [Lumi Agents](https://agents.runlumi.app): carry out bounded digital jobs with tools, worklogs, approvals and verification.

## Editorial principles

Lumi distinguishes evidence from inference, labels direction as direction, and does not claim capabilities, benchmarks or customers it cannot show.
